checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same candle jar and wax preserved on pale kitchen counter
must.why: Same wide jar, cream wax, wooden wick; slightly more tapered but close. Pale speckled counter.

must.item: Warm highlights consistent with upper-left light
must.why: Window glow at upper left, warm highlights on left glass.

must.item: Grounded shadow toward lower right, no contradictory shadow
must.why: Shadow falls to the right/lower right from jar base; no old shadow. Slight oddity: shadow is a long wedge and a bright reflection on the left.

must.item: Glass edges show new setting naturally
must.why: Glass rim and edges are clean with no shelf or plant fragments.

faults.what: Jar slightly reshaped: sides taper a bit more and the base looks a little narrower than the original.
Counter edge/tilt looks odd, with an angled surface and a shadow wedge that is somewhat hard-edged.
Wax top looks slightly different, with a dark wick shadow line.

summary: The candle sits believably on a pale sunlit counter with upper-left light and a lower-right shadow, with only slight jar reshaping and a somewhat odd counter edge.
